RS-2002: classic, highly readable book-style serif. Static instance (no variable axes) -- 359 KB, deliberately chosen over the much larger variable-font Merriweather build for faster loading.

RS-2002: clean geometric sans-serif with excellent readability at small stone sizes; one of the most recognized/requested Google Fonts sans-serifs. READ-003 DATA BUG (not fixed here): this bundled file reports usWeightClass=100 (Thin), where Anton/Great Vibes report 400 -- it is Montserrat Thin shipped under this 'Regular' id and style label, so picking Montserrat silently yields a hairline weight (stemWidthRatio 0.0145, lowest in the library). Fix is a font-file replacement with a render-changing migration for existing projects; tracked in docs/BACKLOG.md. id/family/style/weight/path intentionally left unchanged.

FONT-002: the default Production Font (src/text/rhinestoneFont/families/rsBlock.js) -- every stone position is individually hand-authored, not sampled from a vector outline. `path` is a documentation-only identifier, not a real font file -- RhinestoneFontProvider generates glyph geometry from authored stone centers at runtime and never fetches/parses it (see injectFontFaceRules() in app.js, which only declares @font-face rules for providerId:'opentype' entries). The diagnostic-only RS Block Prototype (SS10) remains intentionally unregistered here.

FONT-002: the second Production Font (src/text/rhinestoneFont/families/rsModern.js) -- a distinct geometric/grotesque style (no serifs, single-story a/g, round bowls) at the same authored pitch as RS Block. `path` is a documentation-only identifier, not a real font file -- see rs-block's own note above for why.

FONT-DECISION-001: the first OpenType/StoneSampler font to clear this project's human-and-metric rhinestone legibility bar -- untransformed (baseline, not the rejected fatten/enlarge-generated variant), rated Readable/Not Sure with zero Unreadable across 48 human-rated items (85.4% Readable) spanning SS6/SS16/SS20 and 16 phrases (12 longform + 4 required), corroborated by 100% vision-transcription exact match and flat clusterCount/zero collisionCount at all 5 stone sizes. See docs/specifications/FONT-DECISION-001-VisionStandardLongformCorpusAndRaterTool.md Part E. FONT-PORTFOLIO-001: also rated at the two remaining sizes (SS10 94%, SS30 94% Readable) -- the only one of the 4-font portfolio with no size disabled (unsupportedStoneSizes: []).

FONT-PORTFOLIO-001: monoline connected script, cleared this project's human rhinestone legibility bar at an overall 58% Readable across SS6/10/16/20/30 -- registered as a production font distinct from the earlier, since-rejected procedurally-transformed 'Sacramento Rhinestone' experiment (FONT-GEN-001/FONT-CAL-001/FONT-CAL-002/FONT-VIS-001, never manifest-registered). SS30 disabled (unsupportedStoneSizes) -- human rating collapsed to 13% Readable at that size specifically; see FONT-DIAG-001's still-open FONT-POLICY-001 recommendation (SS30's own height ceiling, not this font's outline).
